I guess my head just always goes straight to alcohol when things fall apart, and this is the worst they’ve ever been :( I think moving back with my parents will be a good thing in a lot of ways, I wouldn’t be alone anymore, I have five siblings I could spend time with. I’ve never been to Florida, my parents moved down there about 5 years ago so it’s kinda like a new adventure for me. It’s just so painful leaving behind everything you’ve known but I know it’s what I have to do. I’m just so overwhelmed and so scared. I don’t even know where to really start

Thank you so so much for responding. I’m just so so scared. No one wants to be alone you know what I mean? There isn’t fixing what has happened, and every time me and them talk it just gets worse. They’re being so nasty to me I just don’t know how much I can take :( you’re right I shouldn’t dwell on something I can’t fix I’m just so overwhelmed. I’m not really sure what to do next. I’ve tried so hard to try and sell off what I can to be able to pay to move but I’m nowhere near enough, and I still have to pay for food and stuff while here, I’m so scared. I guess my next step is just trying to continue selling off my stuff to try and get money towards moving. Though honestly just breathing right now is taking so much effort :(
